headline.text: L1 S2 caramel held on *bitter taste* after 1-hour separator downtime — sample pulled for R&D, root cause under review.

summary: One active hold: dark/bitter caramel on L1 S2 following separator cleaning delay. L1 S2 metal detector found unplugged during 2nd shift; duration unknown. L3 ML4 spiral conveyors marked clean but not inspected; bars found on re-check.

holds.title: Dark/bitter caramel after separator delay
holds.summary: Caramel turned darker with bitter taste after separator belt cleaning took over an hour; product packed and held pending sensory review and R&D analysis.
holds.status: On hold pending disposition — full jar sample in QA area for R&D.

holds.title: Film roll — incomplete print on packaging
holds.summary: ML2 film roll placed on hold due to incomplete printing on finished packaging; printer from ML3 swapped in at end of 2nd shift.
holds.status: On hold — film roll isolated, printer replaced, five displays reworked.

food_safety.title: S2 metal detector unplugged
food_safety.summary: Metal detector found unplugged during 2nd shift; operator noted it was running moments before; no explanation for disconnect in chat.
food_safety.status: Open — no resolution or investigation update posted in window.

quality.title: S3 melting tank level drop unexplained
quality.summary: Chocolate 10121 in melting tank #1 reported at 62% yesterday end-of-shift, found at 52% this morning — 10% loss unexplained.
quality.status: Open — no investigation or explanation posted.

quality.title: S4 cold tapioca reported at 06:30
quality.summary: Cold tapioca flagged at 06:30 meeting; no follow-up detail on cause, batch disposition, or corrective action in chat.
quality.status: Open — reported at stand-up, no resolution posted.

quality.title: ML2 blurry print — five displays reworked
quality.summary: Printer produced blurry output mid-shift; issue caught quickly, five displays pulled for rework, printer cleaned and returned to service.
quality.status: Resolved — printer cleaned, five displays reworked, line running.

sanitation.title: S4 kitchen and conbar re-clean required
sanitation.summary: Post-clean inspection found residue in kitchen and conbar areas; conbar still looking fatty; Victor flagged for re-clean before production restart.
sanitation.status: Open — re-clean in progress, no pass-off posted at window close.

sanitation.title: ML4 spiral conveyors — checklist vs. actual
sanitation.summary: Spiral conveyors marked complete on checklist but techs had no memory of inspecting; safety chain form incomplete; re-inspection found multiple bars on packaging spiral.
sanitation.status: Open — maintenance working on spirals, no final pass-off posted.

opportunities.text: Consider installing tamper-evident labels or indicator lights on metal detector power connections — based on S2 detector found unplugged with no explanation mid-shift.
Review hold-time limits for S2 separator downtime events — today's 1-hour delay in holding kettle caused sensory deviation requiring full batch hold.
Consider requiring photo evidence or two-person sign-off for spiral conveyor cleaning verification — today's ML4 spirals were marked complete but not actually inspected.
